item.subject: science
item.stem:
On a hot afternoon, Chitra watches dark thunderstorm clouds build over heated fields. The air above the fields is warm and moist.

Which sequence correctly explains how the thunderstorm develops?

options.A: Heated land warms the moist air; the warm air rises and creates low pressure; cooler air flows in; the rising air cools and its water vapour condenses into clouds and rain.
options.B: Warm moist air warms the heated land; the land rises and creates low pressure; cooler air flows in; water vapour condenses into clouds and rain.
options.C: Heated land warms dry air; the dry air rises and creates low pressure; cooler air flows in; clouds and rain form without moist air.
options.D: The same chain produces a thunderstorm even when the air above the fields is cool and dry.
